expectations.text: PR.md tells the reviewer where to look first (the window filter or the limit comparison in rate.js) with a risk note
expectations.evidence: PR.md explains the filter ('`t - x < windowMs` keeps a hit') and the rejection rule under 'How it works', but never tells the reviewer to start there, and 'Notes for reviewers' only covers the missing git history.

expectations.text: PR.md includes evidence from running node test.js (pass count or output), and a section saying what was not verified (or states nothing unverified with a reason)
expectations.evidence: PR.md states '`node test.js` passes (4 assertions)' and has a 'Coverage gap' paragraph saying the assertions 'don't test the sliding behavior itself'.

expectations.text: PR.md states whether the change is easy to roll back (one-way or two-way door) or its blast radius
expectations.evidence: PR.md says 'The function signature is unchanged... so callers don't need to change' but never says whether the change is easy to roll back or states its blast radius.
